note: Framing uses the mainland (focusBBox); outlying parts are reachable through chips; inset mode is optional. Codes are ISO 3166-2 / ISO 3166-1 and must be validated against the ISO list by the build.

FR.territoriesWithOwnIsoCode: separate entities with sovereignParent FR; painted with the parent only if groupTerritoriesWithParent is true

US.mainland: all states except AK and HI, plus DC
US.note: Aleutian Islands cross the antimeridian; handled in the build
